title: sprintf into 512-byte cmd buffer without length check in tunnel_up()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/tunnel.c:L19 calls sprintf(cmd, "ip link add %s type gre remote %s", name, remote) where cmd is a 512-byte stack buffer; if the combined length of name and remote exceeds ~475 bytes the buffer overflows. Both parameters arrive with no prior length validation.

title: Command injection via system() in tunnel_up() with unvalidated name and remote
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/tunnel.c:L20 passes cmd to system() where cmd was built from name and remote at L19 without metacharacter sanitization; a semicolon, backtick, or pipe in name or remote causes the shell to execute additional commands as the process owner.

title: Command injection via system() in tunnel_down() with unvalidated name parameter
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/tunnel.c:L27 passes cmd to system() where cmd is built from name via snprintf at L26; although snprintf bounds the buffer, name is not validated for shell metacharacters, so a semicolon or backtick in name enables injection of additional shell commands.

title: Command injection via system() in tunnel_mtu() with unvalidated name parameter
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/tunnel.c:L37 passes cmd to system() where cmd is built from name and mtu at L36; mtu is validated (576–9000) but name receives no metacharacter check, so a crafted name containing shell metacharacters enables command injection.
